    sm.threat_analysis_metrics->>'anomaly_detection_score' AS anomaly_score

    transactions AS t
JOIN
    riskanalysis AS r
        ON t.txregistry = r.txref

    securitymonitoring AS sm

    (r.network_behavior_analytics->>'transaction_pattern_category')::TEXT AS communication_risk,

SELECT 
    v.vendregistry AS vendor_registry_id, 
    (v.vendrate * v.vendsucccount / NULLIF(v.vendtxcount, 0)) AS relationship_score
FROM 
    vendors v
JOIN 
    products p ON v.vendregistry = p.vendref
JOIN 
    transactions t ON p.prodregistry = t.prodref
GROUP BY 
    v.vendregistry, v.vendrate, v.vendsucccount, v.vendtxcount
HAVING 
    COUNT(t.txregistry) >= 1
ORDER BY 
    relationship_score DESC;

    (mktspan * dlyflow * interscore * esccomprate) / (
        CASE mktclass 
            WHEN 'Forum' THEN 1 
            WHEN 'Service' THEN 2 
            WHEN 'Marketplace' THEN 3 
            WHEN 'Exchange' THEN 4 
        END * 
        CASE sizecluster 
            WHEN 'Mega' THEN 1 
            WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 
            WHEN 'Large' THEN 3 
            WHEN 'Small' THEN 4 
        END
    ) AS market_risk_score
FROM 
    markets;

WITH market_risk_score AS (
    SELECT 
        mktregistry,
        (dlyflow / 1000.0) + 
        (esccomprate * 0.2) + 
        (interscore * 0.3) + 
        (vendcount * 0.1) - 
        (mktspan / 100.0) AS mrs
    FROM markets
)
SELECT 
    m.mktregistry,
    m.mktdenom,
    m.mktclass,
    m.mktspan,
    m.sizecluster,
    m.dlyflow,
    m.mthactive,
    m.vendcount,
    m.buycount,
    m.listtotal,
    m.interscore,
    m.esccomprate,
    m.market_status_reputation,
    mrs.mrs,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY mrs.mrs DESC) as mrs_rank
FROM 
    markets m
JOIN 
    market_risk_score mrs ON m.mktregistry = mrs.mktregistry
ORDER BY 
    mrs.mrs DESC;

WITH market_risk_score AS (
    SELECT 
        mktregistry,
        (dlyflow / 1000.0) + 
        (esccomprate * 0.2) + 
        (interscore * 0.3) + 
        (vendcount * 0.1) - 
        (mktspan / 100.0) AS mrs
    FROM markets
),
ranked_markets AS (
    SELECT 
        mktregistry,
        mrs,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY mrs DESC) AS stability_rank
    FROM market_risk_score
)
SELECT 
    m.mktregistry,
    m.mktdenom,
    m.mktclass,
    m.mktspan,
    m.sizecluster,
    m.dlyflow,
    m.mthactive,
    m.vendcount,
    m.buycount,
    m.listtotal,
    m.interscore,
    m.esccomprate,
    m.market_status_reputation,
    rm.stability_rank,
    rm.mrs AS stability_score
FROM 
    markets m
JOIN 
    ranked_markets rm ON m.mktregistry = rm.mktregistry
ORDER BY 
    rm.stability_rank;

WITH ranked_anomalies AS (
    SELECT 
        riskregistry,
        (
            (network_behavior_analytics->'behavioral_analysis'->>'geo_distribution_score')::NUMERIC +
            (network_behavior_analytics->'behavioral_analysis'->>'temporal_pattern_score')::NUMERIC +
            (network_behavior_analytics->'behavioral_analysis'->>'behavior_consistency_score')::NUMERIC
        ) AS anomaly_score,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (
            (network_behavior_analytics->'behavioral_analysis'->>'geo_distribution_score')::NUMERIC +
            (network_behavior_analytics->'behavioral_analysis'->>'temporal_pattern_score')::NUMERIC +
            (network_behavior_analytics->'behavioral_analysis'->>'behavior_consistency_score')::NUMERIC
        ) DESC) AS rank
    FROM riskanalysis
    WHERE 
        network_behavior_analytics->>'transaction_pattern_category' IN ('High-risk', 'Suspicious')
)
SELECT 
    riskregistry, 
    anomaly_score,
    rank
FROM ranked_anomalies
ORDER BY rank;

06e1e23585716f86f404fb837a2fe8922c249189.sql:
WITH ranked_anomalies AS (
    SELECT 
        riskregistry,
        (
            CAST(
                REPLACE(
                    network_behavior_analytics->'behavioral_analysis'->>'geo_distribution_score',
                    ',',
                    '.'
                ) AS FLOAT
            ) +
            CAST(
                REPLACE(
                    network_behavior_analytics->'behavioral_analysis'->>'temporal_pattern_score',
                    ',',
                    '.'
                ) AS FLOAT
            ) +
            CAST(
                REPLACE(
                    network_behavior_analytics->'behavioral_analysis'->>'behavior_consistency_score',
                    ',',
                    '.'
                ) AS FLOAT
            )
        ) / 3.0 AS anomaly_score,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (
            CAST(
                REPLACE(
                    network_behavior_analytics->'behavioral_analysis'->>'geo_distribution_score',
                    ',',
                    '.'
                ) AS FLOAT
            ) +
            CAST(
                REPLACE(
                    network_behavior_analytics->'behavioral_analysis'->>'temporal_pattern_score',
                    ',',
                    '.'
                ) AS FLOAT
            ) +
            CAST(
                REPLACE(
                    network_behavior_analytics->'behavioral_analysis'->>'behavior_consistency_score',
                    ',',
                    '.'
                ) AS FLOAT
            )
        ) / 3.0 DESC) AS rank
    FROM riskanalysis
    WHERE 
        network_behavior_analytics->>'transaction_pattern_category' IN ('High-risk', 'Suspicious')
)
SELECT 
    riskregistry, 
    anomaly_score, 
    rank
FROM ranked_anomalies
ORDER BY rank;

678b26c23449cd1f7ca11a9dceddaf2ac92dde20.sql:
WITH ranked_patterns AS (
    SELECT 
        ra.riskregistry,
        ra.network_behavior_analytics->>'transaction_pattern_category' AS transaction_pattern_category,
        tam.anomaly_detection_score,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY tam.anomaly_detection_score DESC) AS anomaly_rank
    FROM 
        riskanalysis AS ra
    JOIN 
        securitymonitoring AS sm ON ra.riskregistry = sm.riskref
    JOIN 
        communication AS com ON ra.commref = com.commregistry
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_path_query_array(sm.threat_analysis_metrics, '$.anomaly_detection_score') AS tam(anomaly_detection_score)
    WHERE 
        ra.network_behavior_analytics->>'transaction_pattern_category' IN ('High-risk', 'Suspicious')
)
SELECT 
    riskregistry,
    transaction_pattern_category,
    anomaly_detection_score,
    anomaly_rank
FROM 
    ranked_patterns
ORDER BY 
    anomaly_rank;

f0f9e7b4fbb742414c16786cd04ff47d44ab8f2e.sql:
WITH vendor_trust_index AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        (
            (vendsucccount / vendtxcount) * 100 
            - (venddisputecount / vendtxcount) * 50 
            + (vendrate * 5)
        ) AS vti
    FROM vendors
)
SELECT *
FROM vendor_trust_index
WHERE vti > (SELECT AVG(vti) FROM vendor_trust_index)
ORDER BY vti DESC;

860fb2bc0ac6dae0d1db62a8bf536a9f684e96fe.sql:
WITH vti AS (
  SELECT 
    vendregistry, 
    (vendsucccount / vendtxcount * 100) - (venddisputecount / vendtxcount * 50) + (vendrate * 5) AS vti
  FROM 
    vendors
), 
vrs AS (
  SELECT 
    vendregistry, 
    (
      (
        vendrate * 10
      ) + (vendsucccount / vendtxcount * 50) + (
        CASE vendchecklvl 
          WHEN 'Basic' THEN 1
          WHEN 'Advanced' THEN 2
          WHEN 'Premium' THEN 3
          ELSE 0
        END * 15
      ) - (venddisputecount / vendtxcount * 100)
    ) AS vrs
  FROM 
    vendors
) 
SELECT 
  v.vendregistry, 
  m.sizecluster, 
  vti.vti AS "Vendor Trust Index", 
  vrs.vrs AS "Vendor Relationship Strength" 
FROM 
  vendors v 
  JOIN markets m ON v.mktref = m.mktregistry 
  JOIN vti ON v.vendregistry = vti.vendregistry 
  JOIN vrs ON v.vendregistry = vrs.vendregistry 
ORDER BY 
  "Vendor Trust Index" DESC, 
  "Vendor Relationship Strength" DESC;
